      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/mining_basic.py only as a minor test adjustment.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Contains no changes to block template construction, mining RPCs, or mining interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P label and heavily modifies net_processing and P2P protocol handling with dedicated stale tip relay managers.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Implements block serving and fetching for BIP 332 (Stale Tip Relay) on top of header-only relay. Introducing `-staletips=blocks` with a dedicated best-effort schedule enables nodes to inspect stale-branch transactions without risking peer disconnections from standard block sync expectations, providing substantial strategic value for P2P network observability."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and src/rpc/net.cpp to expose stale tip status.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "RPC adjustments merely expose the underlying P2P stale tip relay state and do not alter the RPC subsystem."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds functional and unit test coverage specifically for stale tip relay.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Extensive unit, functional, and fuzz tests belong to the P2P feature they verify rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp and peerman_args only to wire up the new `-staletips` configuration option.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Configuration argument handling follows directly from the P2P feature and does not change shared utility libraries."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",

      "rationale": "The PR passes through validation interfaces to observe chain tips but does not alter validation rules, UTXO handling, or block connection."
    }
